title: Coward (bc30)
synopsis:
On the Western Front of World War I, young soldier Pierre is eager to prove himself, but repeatedly retrieving the bodies of fallen comrades slowly shatters his courage. When an army show is organized to boost morale, Pierre is assigned to help build the set. On stage, Francis performs as a woman, his captivating charm stirring the young soldier's heart. While war rages outside, an untimely romance quietly takes root between them. Following Close, director Lukas Dhont captures forbidden love blooming against the brutality of war, led by two emerging actors who shared the Best Actor award at Cannes.

 

Best Actor Award, Cannes Film Festival

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
第一次世界大戰，年輕士兵 Pierre 初踏西方戰線，渴望證明自己。一次次坐上卡車前往前線，回收的一具具屍體卻漸漸使他膽怯。此時，軍中需要籌備一場表演，以壯士氣，Pierre 獲擔任指導的 Francis 指派協助佈景。舞台上扮演女角的 Francis 美豔動人，蠱惑着年輕士兵的內心，社會中不被允許的禁忌亦得以呼吸自由的空氣。外邊的戰爭仍在繼續，Francis 與 Pierre 兩人間卻萌生了不合時宜的愛慕。《親陌》導演魯卡斯當敏銳捕捉人物情感，譜寫動盪時代下的禁忌之戀。兩位嶄露頭角的男主角交出最動人演出，一同勇奪康城影帝。

 

康城影展 最佳男主角獎

cast: Valentin Campagne, Emmanuel Macchia, Willem De Schryver
